blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vehicular traffic in the Shaw-Ortigas area from Wednesday, Nov. 4, to Saturday, Nov. 7. is expected to affected by the transportation of one of the Metro Manila Subway Project’s tunnel boring machines. The Department of Transportation (DOTr) announced on Facebook on Monday, Nov. 2, that the possible gridlock is due to the transport of the boring machine from the CP104 Stockyard located at Julia Vargas Avenue in Pasig City to the Shaw Boulevard Station in Mandaluyong City. The said machine will be used in the construction of the tunnels that will connect the subway project’s Shaw Boulevard and […]...
